time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0
image_axes: x right, y down, pixels of the full-resolution 1080x1920 frame
view: top-down (nadir) drone shot of a straight two-lane country road running vertically through the frame; field on the left, woodland and a dirt path on the right; overcast, almost no shadows

camera.motion: static (hovering drone); background shift vs frame 0 <= 0.65 px in x and <= 1.7 px in y (slow drift, see camera_shift.csv); no compensation needed
camera.perspective: nadir view, ground plane ~ parallel to image; one px scale valid across frame to a few %. Wide-angle lens: the same car appears ~5-8% longer near the top/bottom of the frame than near the centre (white car 76 px at y~500-900, 79 px at y~1390, 82 px at y<200; dark car 68-69 px mid, 71-72 px at y>1750).

white_car.desc: white/silver saloon car, left lane (x~536-543), driving UP the image (towards top), front at top

dark_car.desc: dark blue/grey hatchback/estate car, left lane, behind the white car, also driving UP the image

cyclist.desc: cyclist (rider on bicycle, light top) in the right lane (x~570-575), riding DOWN the image (opposite direction to the cars)

bird.desc: small white bird (gull/egret-like) flying from lower right (over the woods, x~982,y~1658) to the left, crossing the road at f57-68, exits the left edge at f139

pixel_size.note: wings flap: bbox 7-16 px; mask PCA length 11-21 px

road.desc: straight asphalt road, vertical through the whole frame
road.asphalt_width_px: 75-77 (edge to edge at half-intensity of the dark kerb lines); ~87 incl. dark kerb/gutter lines (x~515-602)

centre_line_dashes.note: dashes above y~520 are partly under the canopy / near the top; same pattern continues

SLOW_marking.desc: white road text "SLOW" in the right lane (reads for traffic going down)

big_willow_tree.desc: large pale-green/yellow tree left of road, canopy overhangs the left lane

yellow_tree_upper.desc: bright yellow tree left of road below the big tree

yellow_tree_lower.desc: round bright yellow tree left of road

side_path_left.desc: grey paved path curving in from the left edge in the field, lower left

dirt_path_right.desc: brown dirt footpath through the woods, roughly vertical

fence_right.desc: thin fence line just right of the dirt path (x~983-993 at y~1550-1800)

events.event: white car and dark car move up the whole clip, cyclist moves down; no stops, no direction changes
white car passes cyclist (same image row, opposite directions)
bird crosses left road edge x=520
white car under thin canopy branches of big tree (centre still tracked)
dark car front enters canopy of big tree
white car front reaches top edge
white car fully out of frame
dark car mostly hidden under canopy until end
